description: When the copies a U_PDU asks for do not fit one transmission, the rest go in later ones, and each copy's reception window covers the transmissions still needed.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and sends "hello" (priority 0, TTL 0) with Minimum Number of Retransmissions 2: three copies of one 35-byte type 7 D_PDU (address size 3, C-0133) (A-0081, A-0083, C-0848). dts.max_transmission_ms 5550 allows one 64-byte block (600 + 4800 + 150), which holds one copy, so the copies go in three transmissions (C-0884, K-0094, K-0095). csma.num_cont_slots 1 makes every contention wait 0, so LINKING follows each LBT expiry in the same input (K-0080, core-architecture.md 3.3); after each own transmission the LBT wait is lbt_wait_vdcd_ms, 3000 (K-0074). Reception window (C-1051): while copies remain for later transmissions, window = ceil((duration - block start + n x X) / 500), where n is the number of further transmissions the remaining copies need, packed in order into transmissions of the configured length (here one copy each), and X = min(127500, dts.max_transmission_ms) + the LBT wait after an own transmission + csma.num_cont_slots x csma.cont_slot_width_ms + one block of the waveform in use + the 1.5 s host allowance = 5550 + 3000 + 3000 + 4800 + 1500 = 17850 ms (interp C-1292, corpus 0.37.0; 11550 before, without the last two terms). Every transmission lasts 5550 ms and each copy starts at 600 ms. First transmission at 30000: n = 2, window ceil((4950 + 35700) / 500) = 82, so the copies must have gone by 30000 + 600 + 41000 = 71600 (C-0353, C-1052). Second at 38550: it ends at 44100, before 71600, so the copy may go; n = 1, window ceil((4950 + 17850) / 500) = 46, ending 38550 + 600 + 23000 = 62150. Third at 47100: ends 52650, before 62150; n = 0, window = EOT = 10 (C-0350). The C_PDU keeps ID 0 throughout. dts.ttd is cancelled when the last copy is placed (C-1050).
